_about: Names, ending kinds, and argument counts of clause operations, written out from the rows of doeff-hy's CLAUSE-OPS table (packages/doeff-hy/src/doeff_hy/_clause_ops.hy). Generated file - do not edit by hand (fix the table, and regenerate with uv run python scripts/export_clause_ops.py --write). Read by doeff-linter's business_fakes (DOEFF143 etc.) to judge how a clause ends; the reading per ending kind lives in src/project/clause_ops.rs and business_fakes.rs.
